subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as a public native contract for `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents`, or keep parent handoff behavior internal/workaround-only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds durable tool/config semantics in a session-state and message-delivery path where repository policy requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
options.body: Land the linked PR or equivalent after review, keeping `channel` as the default and requiring tests/proof for parent routing, thread-bound spawns, and restart persistence.

options.title: Per-spawn only first
options.body: Accept only the model-facing per-call option and defer global/per-agent defaults until operator and upgrade semantics are reviewed separately.

options.title: Keep workaround-only behavior
options.body: Decline the public contract for now and leave orchestration handoff to explicit `sessions_send` or channel-specific workaround patterns.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR or equivalent after review, keeping `channel` as the default and requiring tests/proof for parent routing, thread-bound spawns, and restart persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool, owns much of the spawn/announce history, and already provided the focused implementation shape in the issue discussion.
